The '''XP-32-1 Landspeeder''' was a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] model manufactured by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. 

[[Merkur's Cab Service]] on [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] operated a fleet of overhauled XP-32-1s piloted by [[V1 pilot droid]]s through a [[scomp link/Legends|scomp link]]. [[Merkur]] had bought some used ones and refurbished them to make his fleet.<ref name="SotEPG" />
